desc: One melee weapon as a blockout mesh. Silhouette and proportion only - the edge comes back rounded, never sharp.
source_prompt: a single straight-bladed longsword standing vertically with the blade tip up, straight crossguard, round pommel, wrapped grip, the whole weapon inside the frame with clear margin on all four sides, three-quarter view, flat mid-grey seamless background, even frontal light, no cast shadow, no hand, no scabbard, no second object
output: untextured GLB mesh, POSITION attribute only, ~525k tris, ~8.5 MB, 19.5 s
usable_for: blockout, silhouette reference, proportion check, sculpt base
not_usable_for: direct game import - needs retopology, UV unwrap and texture bake. Not a sharp-edged asset: surface net rounds every bevel.
note: A blade is a thin part and thin parts are this path's classic failure - at the template threshold 0.6 a blade erodes to nothing or breaks into islands. 0.45 here follows the workflow's own documented fix for thin parts; it has not been rendered per-preset on this box. Blade will still come out with a rounded edge - no iso-surface extraction gives you a sharp one.
